meta.title: OpenClaw for business - from message to finished result
meta.description: I’ll set up OpenClaw, which accepts tasks in Telegram and brings them to fruition in your systems.

hero.title: You send a task. The system delivers the result.
hero.lead: I figure out where you are wasting time and money, connect OpenClaw to the necessary services and set up the safe execution of work through regular chat.
hero.example_request: Change the tariff on the site, show the result and publish it after my confirmation.
hero.example_result: Done: the edits are done, the tests are passed, the preview is waiting for confirmation.
hero.note: I do not sell a set of agents. I am assembling one work circuit for a specific company task.

cases.title: What you can delegate to OpenClaw

items.title: Change website via Telegram
items.text: You describe the edit in chat. OpenClaw transfers it to Codex, launches CI/CD, sends a preview and publishes it only after your confirmation.
items.result: Simple changes are released on the same day.

items.title: Don't lose incoming requests
items.text: OpenClaw immediately responds to the client, asks the necessary questions and passes the manager an already understandable request with contacts and context.
items.result: The manager talks to a ready lead, rather than collecting a questionnaire.

items.title: Prepare a proposal from a voice message
items.text: The manager sends the brief by voice. OpenClaw takes the company's prices and conditions, collects the document and asks for confirmation of the disputed points.
items.result: The client receives an offer before competitors.

items.title: Parse documents without manual entry
items.text: The client sends a file. OpenClaw reads it, checks for required fields and creates a record or task on your system.
items.result: The employee deals only with non-standard cases.

items.title: Receive a ready-made picture of your business in the morning
items.text: OpenClaw collects numbers from CRM, payments and advertising and writes in Telegram where deals are stuck and what needs solving today.
items.result: Instead of several tables, there is a short list of actions.

steps.title: Show your work
steps.text: We call each other and sort out one recurring expensive task.

steps.title: I assemble the workflow
steps.text: Setting up OpenClaw, chat, accesses, actions, checks and launch.

steps.title: Start using it
steps.text: The team works through a familiar interface, and I maintain the system.

offer.title: OpenClaw turnkey
offer.text: You do not receive a consultation or installation instructions, but a working script within your business.
features: analysis of the problem and ready-made script
checks and confirmation of dangerous actions
